query: For my 93‑yo female with TIA: among women 88–98 with TIA, what's the median (IQR) CT/MRI studies per admission for 1–3 vs 4–7 day stays, stratified by ICU use?
final_sql: SELECT i.careunit, CASE WHEN i.careunit IN (SELECT careunit FROM icustays) THEN admissions_1_3.num_studies ELSE admissions_4_7.num_studies END AS num_studies FROM icustays i JOIN (SELECT careunit, COUNT(DISTINCT hadm_id) AS num_studies FROM admissions WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, MIN(dischtime))) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 GROUP BY careunit) AS admissions_1_3 ON i.careunit = admissions_1_3.careunit JOIN (SELECT careunit, COUNT(DISTINCT hadm_id) AS num_studies FROM admissions WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, MIN(dischtime))) BETWEEN 4 AND 7 GROUP BY careunit) AS admissions_4_7 ON i.careunit = admissions_4_7.careunit ORDER BY i.careunit NULLS LAST;
